newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's sees 1996/7 pre-tax profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's sees 1996/7 pre-tax profit rise.

text.p: Partially privatised Egyptian firm General Silos and Storage expects to make pre-tax profits of 70 million pounds ($20.6 million) in the financial year 1996/7, up from 56.32 million in 1995/6, corporate sources said on Monday. The years end on June 30.
The sources said the firm announced the figures at its annual general meeting on Monday. The firm said it had made net after-tax profits of 47.856 million pounds in 1995/6.
The state sold 40 percent of General Silos and Storage last year at 39.00 pounds a share. On Monday, shares closed 2.00 pounds lower at 93 pounds.
